profile.headline: Web developer, graphic designer, and consultant at K-A Designs
profile.summary:
Bilingual cross cultural communicator, dynamic, detailed, and results-oriented, quick learner with offering the ability to assess an organization’s needs and create a complementary, robust web presence. Experienced in all 5 stages of the web development process including: information gathering, planning, design, development, testing and delivery and maintenance. 
Administered online advertisement campaigns based on Web ads, banners, and e-newsletters to drive attention to Web site.
Awarded “Best Web Design” 1999

I have also extensive experience in project management, marketing, logistics, international trade and business, customer service and inside sales. Innovative, conscientious and organized leader with versatile skills to efficiently and effectively complete tasks under pressure.

positions.title: Freelance web developer and consultant
positions.description:
My work has covered a variety of projects, including; designing and building custom eCommerce sites; security, SEO and usability consultation; WordPress and other CMS site and plug-in development. I’ve worked with a range of web technologies including PHP, CSS, mySQL, JavaScript, HTML5, WordPress, AJAX, jQuery (including Mobile and UI).
Duties – Designing websites. Working on projects to strict timescales. Working with a wide range of media including photography and computer software. Preparing photographs for websites.

positions.title: Senior Graphic and Web Designer
positions.description: Worked with clients and corporates developing video content (production, editing, and finishing of high-quality commercial/digital video). Planning, directing, and coordinating marketing design efforts from start to finish. Maintaining website and all social media channels. Building brand awareness. Producing web banners and art according to specs (optimized for digital).

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Maintain websites for clients and businesses. Generate/revise web pages and create/modify appearance and settings on sites. Serve as the server administrator to regulate and manage access rights of different users on websites. Meeting with clients to discuss requirements and/or project progress. Demonstrating and receiving feedback about draft sites. Keeping up-to-date with recent technological and software developments. Developing skills and expertise in appropriate software/programming languages including html, Javascript and others. Working as part of a multi-disciplinary team.

positions.title: Project Management, Inside Sales, Customer Service for the Latin America Market
positions.description:
Improved efficiency of managing overseas orders by implementing a new system to reduce the manpower required to submit orders by 80%.
Established standard operating procedures to streamline communication with overseas offices regarding order statuses.
Increased productivity levels by training coworkers on Microsoft Office and introducing the use of a shared network drive for accessing order documents.
Maintained professional and courteous customer service relations with associates and vendors.
Partnered with sales associates to convert quotes into sales.

positions.title: Corporate Sales and Marketing Division – Logistics Assistant Manager
positions.description:
Assisted with all aspects of developing a new company branch (NEWLINKS) from concept to completion, resulting in a revenue increase of 9% in the first year. 
Participated in marketing NEWLINKS through e-commerce, including an email marketing campaign (using Constant Contact), banner ads, Google AdWords, Google Analytics, and Salesforce.com. 
Highlighted company successes through the design and development of a new department newsletter. 
Supported management and staff in assigned project-based work. 
Conducted research, compiled data and prepared detailed reports for consideration and presentation to Logistics Planning Group management. 
Redesigned the format of company documents for a fresh and more professional look (for example: standard operating procedures, invoices, packing lists, memorandums, fax cover pages, and company letterhead).

positions.title: Lead Office Assistant
positions.description:
Performed logistics transportation functions at the shipping and receiving department. 
Determined the most efficient and economical freight logistics and freight relationships with freight service suppliers.

positions.title: International Export Perishable Agent
positions.description:
Performed logistics transportation functions, including customer service, quoting, billing, and calculation of transit times. 
Determined the most efficient and economical way to move customers’ freight quickly and securely while maintaining the conditions of the shipment. 
Developed knowledge of international trade documentation and TSA regulations.

positions.title: Lead Office Assistant
positions.description:
Performed logistics transportation functions at the shipping and receiving department. 
Attended to all customer requests, such as Proof of Deliveries, Call Tags, Credits, and Requests for Tracers.
Monitored inventory and product transfers between company sites. 
Gained import/export documentation experience.  
Forklift certified.

positions.title: Sales Representative
positions.description:
Signed up new members with the highest degree of courtesy and professionalism.
Offered alternative solutions where appropriate with the objective of ensuring customer satisfaction.
Made financial decisions to protect/collect revenues and adjust customer accounts.
Assisted in training new employees.

positions.title: Ad Server – Latin America
positions.description:
Administered online advertisement campaigns using Dart to allow clients to traffic, target, deliver, and report on their interactive advertising campaigns (email and banner ads). 
Focused on monitoring, administering and reporting customers’ campaigns through the Latin American website network. 
Participated in promotional activities, developed new ideas and created new web content on a daily basis. 
Created weekly reports detailing analysis of campaign results and ideas to improve outcomes.

positions.title: Architect, CAD Designer
positions.description:
Developed objectives, analyzed requirements, and budgeted for projects. 
Provided pre-design services, including conducting feasibility and environmental impact studies and specifying the design.
Prepared drawings and presented ideas for client review and demonstrated flexibility in making necessary changes throughout the planning process.  
Developed final construction plans showing the building's appearance as well as details for its construction. 
Followed building codes, zoning laws, fire regulations, and other ordinances.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Developing site navigation by categorizing content; funneling traffic through content.
Developing site content by designing images, icons, banners, audio enhancements, etc.
Preparing site by installing and configuring server software; installing programming language using authoring and formatting tools; ensuring cross-platform compatibility; establishing links.
Establishing locatability by registering with search engines.
Upgrading site by updating content and graphics; monitoring performance and results; identifying and evaluating improvement options; introducing new technology; maintaining links.
Maintaining site appearance by developing and enforcing content and display standards; editing submissions.
In 1999 this website received the Best Web Design award by yeyeye.com - Argentina

educations.schoolName: University of the Valley of Mexico
educations.degreeName: Bachelor of Science in Architectural Studies

honors.description: In 1999 this website received the Best Web Design award by yeyeye.com - Argentina
